style: Lush nineteenth-century oil-paint and fine engraving hybrid, warm parchment, antique gold, copper, blue and teal. A SINGLE chapter-specific scene, no text labels or multi-panel collages.

characters.phileasFogg: Calm gentleman around forty. BEARDED, with LIGHT hair and LIGHT whiskers as described in the prose. Conservative 1872 English suit.
characters.passepartout: Thirty-year-old French valet, brown slightly tousled hair, lively, practical 1872 servant clothing.

negative: No decorative hot-air-balloon itinerary; do not mix scenes from different chapters; no modern objects, fabricated historical source credit or route claim.

scenes.sourceExcerpt: Mr. Phileas Fogg lived, in 1872, at No. 7, Saville Row
scenes.description: Saville Row townhouse exterior, London 1872; do not claim an authenticated building facade.
scenes.altEn: Modern colored Victorian interpretation of a Saville Row street exterior in 1872.
scenes.altAr: رسم ملوّن حديث لشارع سافيل رو في لندن سنة 1872، دون توثيق الواجهة التاريخية للمنزل.

scenes.sourceExcerpt: A rap at this moment sounded on the door of the cosy apartment
scenes.description: New servant Passepartout bows before seated Fogg as James Forster introduces him.
scenes.altEn: Passepartout bows as he is introduced to the seated Phileas Fogg.
scenes.altAr: باسبارتو ينحني أمام فيلياس فوغ الجالس في لحظة تقديم الخادم الجديد.

scenes.sourceExcerpt: He suddenly observed, hung over the clock, a card
scenes.description: Passepartout alone examines the daily schedule card above the clock in Fogg's house.
scenes.altEn: Passepartout examines a household schedule card above the clock.
scenes.altAr: باسبارتو يتفحص بطاقة جدول المهام اليومية المعلّقة فوق الساعة.

scenes.sourceExcerpt: I will bet twenty thousand pounds against anyone who wishes
scenes.description: Reform Club gentlemen and Fogg discuss his wager; no railway travel in this scene.
scenes.altEn: Phileas Fogg calmly makes his wager before the gentlemen of the Reform Club.
scenes.altAr: فيلياس فوغ يعلن رهانه بهدوء أمام أعضاء نادي الإصلاح.

scenes.sourceExcerpt: He mechanically set about making the preparations for departure.
scenes.description: Passepartout packs for his sudden journey in his London quarters.
scenes.altEn: Passepartout prepares his belongings for an unexpected journey.
scenes.altAr: باسبارتو يجهز أمتعته استعدادًا لرحلة مفاجئة.

scenes.sourceExcerpt: Under his arm might have been observed a red-bound copy of Bradshaw’s
scenes.description: Fogg holds his red-bound Bradshaw railway guide and carries a carpetbag before setting off.
scenes.altEn: Phileas Fogg carries a red-bound railway timetable guide and a travel bag.
scenes.altAr: فيلياس فوغ يحمل دليل مواعيد القطارات ذا الغلاف الأحمر وحقيبة السفر.
